content: It includes citations of research articles, systematic reviews, and global health reports, as well as the names and roles of experts involved in the development of guidelines and recommendations. These references span topics such as abortion stigma, conscientious objection, economic impacts of abortion, legal frameworks, and clinical practices. Additionally, it highlights the involvement of international organizations like the World Health Organization (WHO), United Nations (UN), and other global health entities in addressing reproductive health issues. The document also lists experts from diverse regions and fields, emphasizing their contributions to advancing evidence-based practices and policies in reproductive health.
